pages.title: Ember Seed
pages.text: Fire remnant. Combat builds $(thing)Heat$() for speed and attack speed. Dropped by the Ender Dragon.

pages.title: Dormant and Latent
pages.text: $(l)Dormant$(): Fire immunity. Burns melee attackers.$(br2)$(l)Latent$(): Harmful effects wear off faster, but rain and water become dangerous to you.

pages.title: Awakened, Ascended, Transcendent, Apex
pages.text: $(l)Awakened$(): Unlocks $(thing)Heat$(). Taking or dealing damage builds it. Low health can trigger a fiery recovery burst.$(br2)$(l)Ascended$(): More speed and attack speed from Heat. Some arrows burn up before hitting you. Burning enemies heal you.$(br2)$(l)Transcendent$(): Removes negative effects. Rain no longer matters.$(br2)$(l)Apex$(): Strongest Heat scaling.
